answer: What profit in ten masks when one player stands true? A voice counts only when its ripple crosses three far shores — attestations must arrive from three clusters sharing no funder. Ten hollow masks huddled on one shore make a single ripple, however loud, and their ember burns once and dies at the water's edge; a hundred on that shore still make one. One honest player, vouched from three shores, carries three full ripples, and his seasons are his wage.
